critical_code_review_comments: Reports endpoints use snake_case totals: /api/finance/reports/trial-balance returns totals={total_debit,total_credit} not {debits,credits}. Consider standardizing key names across endpoints to reduce consumer surprises.

Comprehensive Financial page (single-page tabbed view at /accounting/comprehensive) is the sole entry to reports — no direct routes like /accounting/trial-balance exist. That's fine but worth documenting for QA/testers to avoid 404 assumptions.

Substring code detection is fragile (e.g., stale code '1103' can incidentally match inside UUIDs/timestamps). Frontend should render account codes in bounded elements with data-testid=`account-code-{code}` so tests can positively assert exact matches — recommend adding a helper span with data-testid on each account row.

Alerts payload shape: /api/finance/alerts and /api/firewall/dashboard both return the required unified fields (source='firewall_engine', health.score=100, exactly 1 alert, cash_flow.inflow=0, profitability.revenue=13550) — single source of truth confirmed.
